items.title: rename moves the skill folder and the name-made parts itself
items.action: New module harness_lib/strap_rename.py plans the moves from named_paths and the profile's skill folder: each old path that exists moves to its new path (git mv when tracked, Path.rename otherwise); an old path already moved by hand is accepted; a target that already exists refuses before any move, and an old folder holding only untracked leftovers keeps its 'still exists' refusal. strap.py cmd_rename runs the moves before the spec and ledger moves, prints one 'move: <old> -> <new>' line each, and _move_back undoes them in reverse on a failure. --dry-run prints the move lines and changes nothing.

items.title: rename swaps the old name's forms inside the moved parts
items.action: After the moves, each part file (and each moved test file) has the old name's kebab, snake and title forms replaced by the new name's as whole words (the kebab form bounded by non-name characters, the snake form allowed inside identifiers such as demo_skill_api, the title form 'Demo Skill'), the frontmatter name included; one 'swapped-file: <path>:<line>' line per changed line. The original bytes are kept so _move_back restores them.

items.title: cited test files follow the rename; other old-name hits are reported
items.action: A planned test node whose file name carries the old snake form moves with the rename (the file moved and swapped like a part, the node re-pointed, the planned copy moved by _planned_test_moves). git grep over tracked files, outside the parts, the moved files, the spec folder, the ledgers and the artifacts history folders, prints one 'stale-name: <path>:<line>' line per hit of an old form and changes nothing.

items.title: rename --from finishes an earlier rename
items.action: 'strap.py rename <name> --from <old-name>' (new_name omitted) runs the moves, swaps, node re-points and report from <old-name> to the spec's current name, on a frozen spec, without moving the spec or the ledger and without a ledger entry; exactly one of new_name and --from.

items.title: strap-skills documents the new rename and refreezes
items.action: strap-skills SKILL.md 'Rename a skill' and its README row describe the moves, --dry-run, the swapped-file and stale-name lines and --from; docs/RELEASES/v1.1.0.md gains a line. SKILL.md is a strap-skills part, so run the greens of its judgment behaviors on the new hash and refreeze with the developer's OK.

items.title: spec-it finishes its rename from specsheet-lite
items.action: Run rename spec-it --from specsheet-lite: the four tests/*/test_specsheet_lite*.py files move to their spec_it names and B1-B5's planned nodes follow; then refreeze spec-it with the developer's OK.

commands.run: sh plugins/harness/scripts/hpy plugins/harness/scripts/strap.py rename spec-it --from specsheet-lite

decisions.question: Who performs the moves a rename needs?

options.summary: rename runs git mv itself, cross-OS, with --dry-run printing the list
rename prints a move list for the developer to run

decisions.question: What happens to the old name inside files?

options.summary: swap kebab, snake and title forms in the moved parts and cited test files; only report other tracked files

decisions.question: How does a spec renamed before this change finish its rename?

options.summary: rename <name> --from <old-name> runs the moves, swaps and node re-points without moving the spec or ledger
the developer moves the files and edits the nodes by hand

decisions.rationale: The spec's goal for spec-it's leftovers; node ids are locked to the api, so only the driver can move them.
